summary: Mirror classifies export-dir as a write destination and atomically replaces private files without following file symlinks.
reason: Backups contain reading data; preserve existing directory permissions and avoid overwriting symlink targets. This downstream guard remains necessary until the novel command is reprinted with equivalent behavior.
reapply: Keep MCP write-flags export-dir. Write through CreateTemp in the destination directory, descriptor Chmod(0600), close, then rename. Never chmod an existing export directory.
